newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee Gas files $1 bln debt shelf. [CORRECTED 23:59 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Tennessee Gas files $1 bln debt shelf. [CORRECTED 23:59 GMT]

text.p: Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co, a unit of El Paso Energy Corp (corrects to make clear Tennessee Gas Pipeline is no longer a unit of Tenneco Inc.), said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in debt securities.

Tennessee Gas will loan or dividend the net proceeds to El Paso Tennessee. El Paso Tennessee has informed Tennessee Gas it intends to use such funds to reduce amounts outstanding under the El Paso Tennessee Credit Facility, the filing said.

The major business of the Houston, Tx.,based company consists of interstate transportation of natural gas, gas marketing, intrastate pipeline operations, international pipelines and power generation and domestic power generation operations.
